## §3 Stage gates (real git checks — NOT in-memory FIFO)

### CROSS-UMBRELLA gate — clears **Stage 2 only** (BINDING, spec §10 + both kickoffs' §0)

`getff-honest-signals` stages that touch python-lane files — **S3** (both datetime rule
templates + `ruff.toml`) and **S4** (`github-actions-ci.yml` default-branch substitution) —
MUST be merged to `staging` before S2 rewrites the same region.

**Status at 2026-07-25 (`264109608`) — HALF-CLEAR:**

- honest-signals **S3 MERGED** — PR #1150 `fix(python): narrow datetime rules to zero-arg`.
- honest-signals **S4 NOT MERGED** — the file-level probe is the authority, and it is RED:
  `packages/core/templates/python/github-actions-ci.yml:17,19` still read `branches: [main]`.

Re-run BOTH probes before every S2 dispatch attempt (a merge can land between turns):

```bash
gh pr list --state merged --limit 40 --json number,title 2>/dev/null \
  | jq -r '.[] | select(.title|test("honest-signals";"i")) | "\(.number) \(.title)"'
# File-level backstop — the authority for S4 (its deliverable is observable in the tree):
grep -n 'branches:' packages/core/templates/python/github-actions-ci.yml
```

S4 unmerged (`branches: [main]` still present) → **S2 is BLOCKED.** Do NOT dispatch it. S1 is
unaffected (disjoint files: `packages/core/synthesizer` + `packages/core/research` vs
`setup.d/` + `packages/core/templates/python/`) and may proceed. Escalate the ordering to the
operator rather than reordering the umbrella yourself.

### Stage 1 → Stage 2

```bash
gh pr list --search "is:merged head:getff-any-stack-trace-s1 base:staging" --json number,title,mergedAt,headRefName --limit 10
```

### Stage 2 → Stage 3

```bash
gh pr list --search "is:merged head:getff-any-stack-trace-s2 base:staging" --json number,title,mergedAt,headRefName --limit 10
```

### Stage 3 → Stage 4

```bash
gh pr list --search "is:merged head:getff-any-stack-trace-s3 base:staging" --json number,title,mergedAt,headRefName --limit 10
```

Expected: non-empty JSON per gate. Empty → halt; do NOT dispatch the next stage.

**Phase -1 cold-review between every stage transition is MANDATORY** (see §7).

**Re-probe obligation:** re-run the pre-dispatch in-flight probe (CLAUDE.md operational
conventions) immediately after each Phase -1 review completes and before the actual dispatch —

Each stage is one implementer session on its own worktree, one PR onto `staging`.

**Worktree:** `bash scripts/create-worktree.sh getff-any-stack-trace-s<N>` (portable form;
`claude -w <name>` is the CC-native equivalent). Branch: `getff-any-stack-trace-s<N>`.

- **S1 — trust threading + D7 (spec §4).** Thread manifest-derived `ResolveCtx` into the
  generation path (`packages/core/synthesizer/research-to-node.ts` /

  (`github.com` remains ineligible). Honesty gate = the three committed fixtures (spec §4.4):

  `fastapi.tiangolo.com`), reject (dependency absent → `research-only`). **Each accept fixture

  (`research-to-clippy-node.ts`) included if cheap, else explicitly deferred to

  live that FastAPI + SQLAlchemy PyPI metadata still carry the Documentation project-URLs
  (verified 2026-07-23; registry metadata moves).
- **S2 — agent surface on the python lane (spec §5 + D8). GATED — see §3 cross-umbrella gate.**
  `do_python_lane` grows a delivery phase: skills (`getff`, `rule-research`, `rule-tests`,
  `tool-bootstrapping`), agents (`rule-researcher`, `rule-test-author`), hooks
  (`deps-hash-check` + `.claude/settings.json` wiring; `inject-matching-rule` per
  honest-signals S6 semantics), `.mcp.json`, starter `AGENTS.md`, `.ai-factory/` agent-surface
  subtree. **SAME stage:** narrow `tests/install-sh/python-entry-lane.test.sh:51-53` (drop

- **S4 — acceptance mechanisms + closure (spec §9.1 + §9.3).** W6 cell v1 in

## §4b §1.7 PR-body authoring mandate (paths-triggered — self-evaluate per stage)

S3 and S4 touch `agents/**` and `INSTALL-FOR-AI.md`; S4 also touches
`packages/core/principles/**`. Those stages MUST carry the §1.7 sections in the **PR body**.
S1/S2 self-evaluate against the path list below.

Triggering paths: `.claude/rules/**`, `packages/core/principles/**`,
`docs/meta-factory/EXECUTION-PLAN.md`, `docs/meta-factory/prior-art-evaluations.md`,
`CLAUDE.md`, `packages/core/templates/**`, `.claude/skills/**`, `agents/**`.

**Required PR body sections (verbatim shape — the CI substance gate is strict):**

```markdown
### §1.7 Forward-check applied

<≥40 non-whitespace chars enumerating which existing disciplines were checked>

- `doc-authority-hierarchy.md` — <what was checked>. file:line evidence: `<path>:<line>`
- `phase-research-coverage.md §1.12` — <what was checked>. file:line evidence: `<path>:<line>`
- `build-first-reuse-default.md` — <verdict + rationale>
- `no-paid-llm-in-ci.md` — <verdict>

### §1.7 Backward-check applied

<≥40 non-whitespace chars enumerating the sweep of sibling surfaces under this change's class>

- `<sibling-surface>` — SWEPT-CLEAN or GAP-FOUND. file:line evidence: `<path>:<line>`
```

**Hard rules (each has historically failed the gate):**

1. **Heading depth = H3 (`###`), NOT H2.** The awk regex matches `^### §1\.7 ...`.
2. **The word «applied» is required.**
3. **≥40 non-whitespace chars in EACH section body.**
4. **≥1 file:line citation per section** matching `[^[:space:]]+\.[a-z]+:[0-9]+`.
5. Escape hatch for purely structural PRs: `### §1.7 Skipped: <rationale ≥60 chars>`.

**Pre-flight grep — run BEFORE `gh pr create` (compose `$PR_BODY` first):**

```bash
echo "$PR_BODY" | grep -cE '^### §1\.7 (Forward|Backward)-check applied'  # must be 2
echo "$PR_BODY" | awk '/^### §1\.7 Forward-check applied/{c=1;next} /^###/{c=0} c' | tr -d '[:space:]' | wc -c   # ≥40
echo "$PR_BODY" | awk '/^### §1\.7 Backward-check applied/{c=1;next} /^###/{c=0} c' | tr -d '[:space:]' | wc -c  # ≥40
echo "$PR_BODY" | grep -cE '[^[:space:]]+\.[a-z]+:[0-9]+'  # ≥2
```

**T21 warning specific to this umbrella:** the backward-check sibling surfaces here are the
**other lanes (js / rust)** — name each as SWEPT-CLEAN or GAP-FOUND with evidence. A
backward-check whose file list equals this stage's own diff is non-conformant by format.

Additionally, `staging` requires the `fidelity-verdict-in-pr-body` check — every stage PR
carries its fidelity verdict.

## §4c Autonomous aif-handoff dispatch — park-don't-guess contract

> **When live:** only if a stage is dispatched via
> `npx tsx packages/runtime-bridge/src/cli/dispatch.ts <this-kickoff>` instead of a
> maintainer-pasted CC tab. If every stage runs in a pasted tab, §4c is inert.

**Why:** aif-handoff agents have **no mid-implementation «pause and ask» primitive**. They
implement — *guessing* on any ambiguity — then auto-review post-hoc. A genuine design fork is
not recognised as a question; aif just picks and proceeds. **This umbrella carries an explicit
open fork (F-A, spec §12)** — without the levers below, aif will decide it silently.

**Lever 1 — conservative aif config (set BEFORE dispatch):**

```bash
export AGENT_MAX_REVIEW_ITERATIONS=1
export AGENT_AUTO_REVIEW_STRATEGY=closure_first
export AGENT_SKIP_REVIEW=false
```

**Lever 2 — park-don't-guess instruction (verbatim, addressed to the aif agent):**

> **aif agent — fork discipline (non-negotiable):** On ANY genuine fork or ambiguity (two
> defensible implementations, an undecided design choice, a missing spec detail that changes
> behaviour) — **do NOT pick.** Park it as a question (set the task to
> `manualReviewRequired` / `blocked_external` with the fork stated as «Option A → consequence
> X / Option B → consequence Y») and **stop that task.** Proceed only on the unambiguous
> parts. Guessing a fork to «keep moving» is the failure this whole loop exists to prevent.
> **In this umbrella, F-A (S3, bundle-vs-declare for the generation CLI's Node dependency) is
> a KNOWN fork — park it, do not resolve it autonomously.**

**Lever 3 — the resolve loop reviews aif's DECISIONS, not only its open questions.**

**Pre-dispatch gate:** `grep -qi 'park it as a question' <this-kickoff>` AND
`[ -n "$AGENT_MAX_REVIEW_ITERATIONS" ]` AND `RUNTIME_BRIDGE_AIF_PROJECT_ID` set
(run `refresh-aif-base.sh` first). Any missing → STOP; use paste-tabs.

**Egress gate (mandatory after `status=done`):** aif does NOT push or open PRs by design.

```bash
npx tsx packages/runtime-bridge/src/cli/harvest.ts <taskId> --base staging
```

Skipping this leaves the work permanently in the container
(`#autonomous-done-no-harvest`).

## §5 AI-traps active (per `ai-laziness-traps.md §3`)

See `.claude/rules/ai-laziness-traps.md §2` for the full catalogue.

**Active canonical traps for getff-any-stack-trace: T1, T3, T7, T11, T15, T19, T20, T21.**

- **T1** — «two fixtures pass, D7 works». The honesty gate is three fixtures (two accept, one
  reject) and each accept asserts the admitting tier. Fewer = a sampling artifact.
- **T3 / T20** — every anchor re-verified live at stage entry; quoted tool output on every
  «works» claim. No prose-only findings.
- **T7** — this kickoff's stage list is not a checklist to tick; reason against it. The
  cross-umbrella gate in §3 is real, not decorative.
- **T11** — S1's D7 extension and S4's one-beat protocol are near-capability surfaces: BFR
  consult before building, and the `Prior-art:` trailer's verdict must match what the diff
  actually does (`#consult-as-trailer-not-input`). SSOT #183/#223 are the existing anchors.
- **T15** — S4's one-beat protocol IS the recursive self-application: the framework's own
  shipped docs are the system under test.
- **T19** — own adversarial cold-QA before handoff at every stage. Green CI ≠ design review.
- **T21** — backward-check in the enumeration format. Sibling surfaces here are the **other
  lanes (js / rust)** — name them SWEPT or GAP; do not restate the diff.

**Domain-specific traps (getff-any-stack-trace-specific, NOT in the canonical catalogue):**

- **T-AST-A — Tier-0 leak masquerading as Tier-1 success.** An accept fixture can pass merely
  because the host happens to be Tier-0-listed, proving nothing about the threading this
  umbrella exists to build. **Counter:** accept fixtures assert the ADMITTING TIER and use
  hosts absent from `packages/core/research/allowlist.ts` — verified 2026-07-24:
  `fastapi.tiangolo.com` and `docs.sqlalchemy.org` are absent (0 matches). **Keep it so** —
  re-run the grep at S1 entry.
- **T-AST-B — warm one-beat run reported as cold.** Running the S4 protocol with framework
  sources or this kickoff in context and calling it a cold run. **Counter:** the protocol agent
  receives ONLY the consumer project path; its prompt is part of the shipped artifact and says
  so explicitly.
- **T-AST-C (meta-launch-specific) — dispatching S2 on the assumption that honest-signals
  «will land first».** The §3 cross-umbrella gate is a real `gh` check, not an expectation.
  As of 2026-07-24 `getff-honest-signals` has **zero PRs of any state**. **Counter:** run the
  gate command and read its output before every S2 dispatch attempt; empty → S2 stays blocked
  and the ordering is escalated to the operator.

> **Anti-pattern warning:** a blanket «see ai-laziness-traps.md» without the enumeration above
> is itself a T7 violation.

## §7 Phase -1 reviewer dispatch (between stages)

Before dispatching Stage N+1:

```text
Agent: Phase -1 cold-review for getff-any-stack-trace Stage N
Role: reviewer (not orchestrator, not implementer)
Skill: requesting-code-review
```

The reviewer reads the Stage N diff (`git diff staging...getff-any-stack-trace-s<N>`) and the
stage's «works» criteria from §4, then emits GO / REVISE / STOP with BLOCKER / MAJOR / MINOR
classification. For any finding requiring a strategy choice it emits «DECISION-NEEDED: …
Option A → consequence X. Option B → consequence Y. Maintainer decides.» — it does **not** pick
the strategy, does not edit files, and does not skip review because CI is green (T19).

Verdict routing: **GO** → re-probe in-flight, then dispatch Stage N+1. **REVISE** → surface
findings, worker fixes, repeat Phase -1. **STOP** → escalate, halt.

Any session message produced from this kickoff (Worker REPORT, Reviewer verdict, mid-stage
status, final handoff) ends with a `## 🟢 In plain words` block naming orchestration
substance — sub-waves, «works»-criteria items, file:line, REPORT traces — not per-turn

## §8 Stop conditions

- The §3 cross-umbrella gate returns empty and S2 is the next stage → **halt S2**, proceed
  with S1 only, escalate the ordering.
- Any stage gate returns empty while Stage N was expected merged → halt, report.
- Phase -1 reviewer returns STOP → halt, surface to the operator.
- Any stage returns a BLOCKER finding → halt the stage before proceeding.
- The T-AST-A grep shows `fastapi.tiangolo.com` or `docs.sqlalchemy.org` has appeared in
  `allowlist.ts` → halt S1; the honesty gate is void until the fixture hosts are re-chosen.
- S1's live D7 external-fact check shows the PyPI Documentation project-URLs have moved →
  halt S1, surface; the fixture premise changed.
- Any `gh` command errors → halt, escalate.
- Any temptation to edit `~/.claude/skills/orchestrator/` → violation; stop.

## §9 Anti-scope

- Do NOT write stage implementation code in this kickoff.
- Do NOT resolve fork F-A here — S3's planner owns it, with the rationale recorded in the PR body.
- Do NOT collapse stages into one PR (the umbrella kickoff §1 forbids it).
- Do NOT reorder the umbrella to route around the cross-umbrella gate — escalate instead.
- Do NOT script against the live polygon `~/code/apiapp` in CI (operator-side, not a fixture).
- Do NOT touch npm-publish / `npx getff init` (spec §11 non-goal).
- Do NOT add npm deps (substrate purity per `no-paid-llm-in-ci.md` + BFR-default).
- Do NOT modify `~/.claude/skills/orchestrator/` (agent-uncommittable).
